purpose: Prospective admission map for extending C3X beyond the Stockfish lineage without equating syntactically similar caches or UCI interfaces with the same causal variable.

abstract_intervention_target.name: persistent_search_memory_read_mediation
minimum_semantics: a persistent search-state store survives across revisitations within one root search
reads can change search evaluation, bound use, cutoff eligibility, or move ordering
all semantically admitted reads can be mediated at source
NATIVE and SHAM are behaviorally identical under fixed resource control
FULL_MASK removes admitted semantic read availability while preserving writers and unrelated search state
forbidden_shortcuts: having a structure named TT implies causal equivalence
same programming language implies causal equivalence
same alpha-beta label implies identical intervention semantics

berserk.reason: Search architecture exposes PVS, quiescence and TT semantics close enough to motivate an admission attempt, but read-site completeness and semantic role equivalence must be proved independently.

ethereal.reason: Source-visible alpha-beta/TT lineage is suitable for a separate semantic-use census; current public repository history must be version-locked before any intervention.

inanis.reason: Useful for language-independent transport because it is Rust-based while retaining an alpha-beta/TT family; admission still requires its own semantic mediation proof.

lc0.reason: Stockfish TT-read masking is not a homologous causal intervention on Lc0 tree statistics, neural cache, or search-state reuse. A new architecture-neutral persistent-search-memory variable must be constituted first.

future_cross_engine_design.phase_1: Admit one non-Stockfish alpha-beta/TT engine only after byte/source lock, semantic read census, NATIVE/SHAM noninterference and FULL_MASK equivalence.
future_cross_engine_design.phase_2: Run the same fresh exact-world matched-square design under the admitted abstract intervention and compare relation curvature, not raw telemetry counts.
future_cross_engine_design.phase_3: Only after at least two independently admitted alpha-beta engines may C3X promote a cross-engine mechanism law.
future_cross_engine_design.phase_4: Lc0-class engines require a separate abstraction proof and may join only at the level of a newly constituted persistent-search-memory causal variable.

relationship_to_p19: No candidate in this file can alter P19 engine membership, thresholds, squares, predictions, or verdict.
